spans.s:
m. (-क्षः)
1 Bondage, confinement.
2 Confinement to life.
mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Unliberated, unloosed.
E.
अ neg. मोक्ष liberation.

mfn. (-घः-घा-घं)
Productive, fruitful, not vain or barren.
m. (-घः)
The name of a river.
f. (-घा)
1 Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.)
2 A plant of which the seed is used as a vermifuge, (Erycibe paniculata, Rox.) See बिडङ्ग.
3 Yellow myrobalan. See हरीतकी.
E.
अ not, मोघ vain, barren.

n. (-नं)
Non-liberation, not loosing or letting go.
E.
अ neg. मोचन loosing.

n. (-नं)
1 Loosing, liberating.
2 Emitting, shedding, letting forth or out.
E.
आङ् before मुच to liberate, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Confined, not liberated.
E.
अ neg. मोचित loosed.

m. (-दः)
1 A fragrancy, a diffusive perfume.
2 Strong smell.
3 Pleasure.
E.
आङ्, मुद to be pleased, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
Delighting, rejoicing.
E.
आङ् before मुद to please, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Pleased, delighted.
2 Fragrant.
E.
आङ् before मुद with क्त aff.

Happy, delighted.
m. (-दी)
A perfume for the mouth, made up in the form of a pill or bolus of camphor, &c.
E.
आमोद and णिनि aff.

mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि)
A thief, who or what steals.
E.
आङ् before मुष to steal, घिनुण् aff.
